Renaissance, commonly known as Renaissance Fine Consignment, is an American chain of luxury consignment boutiques with locations in El Dorado Hills and Santa Barbara, California. The company specializes in high-end, authenticated designer goods. The business is part of the growing luxury resale market, which has gained popularity as consumers seek out sustainable and high-value fashion.
History
The Renaissance brand was founded by Holland Hawthorne and is based on a business model with over 13 years of experience in the high-end consignment industry. Hawthorne was featured as a local business owner in the Santa Barbara Independent's "Downtown Business Spotlight" in late 2020.
The company operates using a franchise model, which allows for the establishment of individually owned boutiques. The El Dorado Hills store, owned by Kendra Clark, held its grand opening in the spring of 2023. The store's opening was also featured in Style Magazine as a notable local happening.
Operations
Renaissance offers a curated collection of authenticated luxury brands, including Chanel, Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, and David Yurman. The business operates on a consignment model where individuals can bring in their gently used luxury items. The store's staff then authenticates and prices each piece based on its condition, brand, and current market value before it is placed for sale.
Locations
The company has two locations in California:
El Dorado Hills: 4357 Town Center Boulevard, Suite 116, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762.
Santa Barbara: Located in La Arcada Plaza on State Street.
